work.title: Add architectural dependency tests
work.description: Introduce tests that enforce the intended dependency direction: core imports no application, adapters, or cli; application imports no cli; cli may depend on application and core; adapters may implement application ports. Additional rules prevent adapters from becoming lifecycle authorities, Worktrees from containing application policy, and package entrypoints from producing import-time side effects. The rules are documented.
acceptance: Tests do not require a new runtime dependency
At least one deliberately invalid fixture proves the rules detect violations
